verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken structure. The background photo has become an empty brown box that takes up about a third of the canvas, while the product bag is shrunk into a small tile. The logo is moved down beside the bag at the same weight instead of heading the layout. 'on' sits alone on its own line, and the body copy is cramped. B is almost identical, but its oversized SAVE 15% badge competes with the headline more than A's smaller badge does, so A is marginally less bad.
